readme_rewrite:
# Booking Widget [![build](https://img.shields.io/badge/build-ok-green)](https://img.shields.io) [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@example-booking/widget)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@example-booking/widget) [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE) Booking widget for any website: an embeddable appointment booking calendar in plain JavaScript, with a React wrapper, for developers adding online booking to their own or a client's site. ## Install Works in the last 2 versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari and Edge. The React wrapper needs React 18 or later. ```bash npm install @example-booking/widget ``` ## Embed a booking calendar in 3 lines ```html
``` ```js import { BookingWidget } from "@example-booking/widget"; BookingWidget.mount("#booking", { apiKey: "YOUR_KEY" }); ``` `YOUR_KEY` is the public widget key from your Example Booking dashboard (Settings, then Developer). With your own backend, use a custom adapter instead; it needs no key. [TO FILL: link to the custom adapter guide] You should see a month calendar with the open slots in `#booking`. Clicking a slot opens the booking form. [TO FILL: a screenshot of the rendered calendar, with alt text such as "Month calendar with open appointment slots"] ## Features - Month, week and day views - Slots shown in the visitor's time zone - Deposits through the Example Booking adapter - A custom adapter for any backend - Keyboard and screen reader support - 9 KB gzipped ([bundle size report](https://www.example.com/docs/widget/bundle-size/)) ## React The React wrapper needs React 18 or later. Its import and props are in the [React guide](https://www.example.com/docs/widget/react/). [TO FILL: the React example from the React guide, import line included] ## When to use it Use the widget when booking should sit inside your own page, on any site where you can add a script tag. It is the front end only: the slots and bookings come from the backend you connect, Example Booking or your own through a custom adapter. If you want a hosted booking page to link to without writing code, Example Booking's hosted booking page does that. It is not a WordPress plugin. ## Questions ### How do I add a booking widget or embed a booking calendar on my website? Install the package, add an empty `div` with an id, and call `BookingWidget.mount` with that id and your key, as in the example above. ### Can I use the booking widget without an Example Booking account? Yes. Use a custom adapter for your own backend; it needs no key. [TO FILL: link to the custom adapter guide] ### Does the booking widget work with React? Yes, through the React wrapper, which needs React 18 or later. See the [React guide](https://www.example.com/docs/widget/react/). ### Can I embed a booking calendar in WordPress? Yes, on any site where you can add a script tag, including WordPress through a Custom HTML block. It is not a WordPress plugin. ### What is an appointment booking widget? A booking calendar you embed in your own page. This one shows the open slots in a month calendar, and clicking a slot opens the booking form, so visitors book without leaving your site. ## Docs - [Widget docs](https://www.example.com/docs/widget/) - [React guide](https://www.example.com/docs/widget/react/) - [Releases](https://github.com/example-booking/booking-widget/releases) ## Contributing See the [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md). ## License [MIT](LICENSE)
